sourceFilename: 製造 分野 特定技能  1号 評価 試験機械 電気電子機械組み立て 区分テキスト.pdf
visualMethod: Rendered physical pages with PyMuPDF at 1x, inspected all20 pages in five2x2 composites. Images, tables, arrows, formulae, captions, panels and footer numbers read. Text extraction used only for index navigation. Source renderings scratch-only.

scopes: Screwdriver/nut-driver/spanner families table; head interface and two-flat sizing; direction illustration.
Hex-key/torque-wrench table; slotted/cross/tapping/hex-bolt types table.
Nut/plain/spring/captive washers and trapezoidal thread continuation table; ISO/JIS names treated as source examples, not current exhaustive standard list.
Chassis-tool table: scriber,punch,drill,hole saw,tap,die,end mill,hacksaw,file; tool photos and roles.
Definition panel: jig,burr,marking; wiring ratings text visually read but not newly taught in this batch.
Dial gauge displacement pointer; height gauge and hole-depth limitation; ruler end datum and marks; surface plate datum.
Analog/digital tester photographs, mirrored scale reading and resistance zeroing; retained as read context, not new tester lesson or copied source exercise.
Top source exercise explanation read; LCR meter L/C/R/impedance and automatic bridge mechanism; device image.
Thermocouple two-metal/junction-temperature diagram and type-K range statement; illuminance/photodiode text; gauss/Hall sensor diagram and field/current/voltage directions.
Chassis marking/position check; punch,drill,large hole preparation and burr-removal figure C0.5 source example.
Large opening relief-hole/cut/file process sketch; definition of tapping; existing thread forming/self-tapping distinction.
Hand-tapping preparation sequence,center drill,lower hole,oil and tap handle; approximate lower-hole ratio and tool-sequence qualification.
Source practice T/F questions and explanations visually read for consistency only; no questions or answer patterns copied.
File cross-section icons: flat,half-round,round,square,triangular; single-cut angles and push-direction figure; cut pattern families.
Small needle-file types and sets photograph; detailed assembly finishing role.
Point-charge force equation and unlike/like-charge arrows; electric-field,conductor,insulator definitions.
Magnetic field and parallel-current force arrows; same-current attraction/opposite-current repulsion.
Fleming left-hand photograph and three-axis magnetic-field/current/force figure.
Fleming right-hand photograph and motion/field/induced-current diagram; EMF definition and unit.
Source induction/force T/F explanation visually read for discrimination; original four-choice scenarios independently authored.

qualifications: Source p105 type-K temperature range is not generalized; existing October1erratum retained and learner told to use product-specific range.
Source p109 lower-hole80–85% is an approximate explanatory heuristic; lesson requires thread/pitch/material/method-specific specified table.
Source tapping tool sequence and alternating turns are not universal to every tap type; lesson specifies tool-matched process.
Source C0.5 chamfer is a shown example, not taught as universal required chamfer.
Spanner size refers to two-flat distance; bolt nominal thread diameter is a separate quantity.
Washer types are distinguished without asserting spring washers universally prevent loosening or arbitrary substitution is permitted.
Dial gauge resolution is model-dependent; hypothetical0.01mm is explicit in new activity/question, not guaranteed accuracy.
Thermocouple reference junction and measuring junction distinguished; thermocouple type alone does not certify range.
Right-hand rule taught as induced-EMF direction, with induced-current direction conditional on closed circuit; avoids implying current in any open conductor.
Parallel-current force and Coulomb inverse-square calculation state idealized conditions.
All source practice questions read as technical-context verification only. New4-choice stems,numeric values,options and explanations independently authored.
No current legal/standards requirement is newly asserted; named standards in source photos/tables not used as proof of present editions.
